name: Killing In Self Defense
overview: Scripture upholds the sanctity of human life, declaring that God requires accountability for the shedding of life, whether by man or beast, emphasizing the seriousness of taking a life (Genesis 9:5). The commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) sets a clear moral standard, yet the law also recognizes circumstances where killing may occur without guilt, such as when a thief is killed during a break-in (Exodus 22:2). Restoration is mandated when property is unlawfully destroyed (Exodus 22:1), and the penalty for unlawfully killing a man is death (Leviticus 24:21). Furthermore, God equips His people for defense and battle (Psalms 144:1), indicating that while life is precious, God empowers His followers to protect themselves when necessary.
